items.question: Which youthful aspect is commended as praiseworthy in initiation, O trembling-eyed one?
premises: A youthful aspect is the subject under consideration.
This youthful aspect is declared praiseworthy.
items.inference: Therefore, the youthful aspect is commended in the context of initiation.
uncertainties: The precise referent of yuvatī+kalā (youthful phase, art, or quality) is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And, O trembling-eyed one, the youthful aspect is praised in initiation.
